auth.title: Sign in

auth.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
auth.tooShort: New password must be at least 6 characters.
auth.forceSubtitle: This account still uses the default password. Set a new one to continue.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Your sign-in, appearance and calendar preferences.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.allStaffed: Every shift in this period is fully staffed.
dashboard.noShifts: No shifts scheduled in this period.

personnel.emptyBody: Add your first person to start building availability.
personnel.skillsHint: Only people with a matching skill are assigned to a shift.

positions.emptyBody: Add your first position to start defining shifts.
positions.requiredSkillsHint: Only people with every selected skill can fill this shift.
positions.preferredHint: Assigned first when available — at most {{count}} (the staff count).
positions.noPreference: No preference set — anyone eligible can fill this.
positions.limitReached: Limit reached. Raise the staff count to prefer more people.
positions.noEligible: No employees match the required skills.
positions.noOtherEligible: No other employees match the required skills.
positions.groupHint: Cluster related positions in the sidebar — e.g. all kitchen roles.
positions.defaultSkillsHint: Suggested when you create a new shift here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Skills, working-time rules and the solver window.
settings.darkModeHint: Switch between light and dark themes.
settings.nameOrderHint: Which name leads in lists and labels.
settings.timeSnapHint: Granularity when drawing or dragging blocks.
settings.skillsDesc: The skills people can have and shifts can require. Renaming or removing a skill updates everyone and every shift that uses it.
settings.rulesDesc: Global limits that apply to everyone. People inherit these unless they set their own rule for the same metric, and a personal rule can only be stricter. Tightening a rule here updates anyone whose personal rule was looser.
settings.solverDesc: The solver runs continuously over this window and pauses automatically once the schedule is steady. Changing any setting re-solves from the new state.
settings.timeRangeHint: Counted from the beginning of the next full day, week or month. One week means this week and the next.
settings.coverageHint: Live coverage and the Solve / Pause controls are on the Shift Plan view.

skills.empty: No skills yet — add the first one below.
skills.confirmRemove: Remove the skill “{{name}}”? It will be removed from every person and shift that requires it.

rules.title: Working time rules
rules.emptyPersonal: No rules yet — add one to constrain this person's hours, or set system-wide rules in Settings.
rules.emptyGlobal: No global rules yet — add one to apply it to everyone.
rules.personalHint: Preferred rules are soft goals; "at least" / "at most" are hard limits. Global rules apply to everyone and can only be tightened.

shiftplan.scrollLoad: Scroll sideways to load more days

plan.pickPersonBody: Choose someone to see the shifts they're assigned.
plan.pickPositionBody: Choose a position to see who is working each shift.

calendar.overlapAvail: This overlaps another availability entry. Entries can’t overlap — except vacation, which spans the whole day.
calendar.overlapShift: This overlaps another shift. Shifts can’t overlap.
calendar.overlapAvailOtherDay: That overlaps another availability entry on a different day.
calendar.overlapShiftOtherDay: That overlaps another shift on a different day.
calendar.repeatingApply: This is a repeating entry — apply the change to:
calendar.endDateHint: Leave empty for a single day, or set an end date to cover several days.
calendar.weeklyHint: Repeats every week on the selected days.
calendar.affectsPastBody: This {{action}} affects {{when}} before today. Are you sure?
